## Goal
A test that walks the Typer app in `src/freemyid/cli.py` (read only) and checks: every registered command and subcommand
appears in the docs/CLI.md command table; every `freemyid <words>` example in docs/CLI.md, README.md and docs/USER_GUIDE.md
resolves to a real command or subcommand. Hidden options/commands (such as `run --scheduled`) are exempt.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Passes on main after WO-120 merges. Any remaining real mismatch: strict xfail on that case only, with a reason.
- Uses Typer/Click introspection (no subprocess, no network, no new dependencies). `ruff check tests` passes.

- VENDOR_STATUS.md
